description: Historical experiment records of the Anima3 training lineage, imported as byte-exact copies. Selection in an experimental registry is never a public deployment.

result.failed_gate: Recorded gates failed or the candidate was not selected.
result.simulator_only: A gain, if any, was measured only in the approximate simulator.
result.negative: No gate; the recorded result showed no improvement or a regression.
result.diagnostic: Mechanics, audit, fit or infrastructure evidence; no strength claim.
result.invalidated: Halted or confounded; its results are not usable.

selection.registry_selected: Named by selected_sha of an experimental registry (run-local for simulator runs). Not a deployment.
selection.registry_retained: Incumbent kept by an experimental registry after a candidate failed.
selection.rollback: Rollback checkpoint recorded beside a registry selection.
selection.offline_selected: Chosen in an offline or simulator comparison; no registry.
selection.rejected: Failed its gate or was not chosen in the recorded comparison.
selection.invalidated: Withdrawn because its training or evaluation data was confounded.

deployment.not_deployed: No record shows this policy serving public players.
deployment.public_deployment: Requires deployment_evidence naming an indexed record whose kind is deployment_evidence. No such record exists.

domain.live_server_unranked: Unranked training matches on the arena host with training accounts; not a public deployment.

training_tip_version.relation: byte prefix of this file; baaaaef only appends the remaining-17 section

experiments.title: Ten-match Jev strategy adaptation
experiments.hypothesis: A Jev plus local Qwen tactic selector that reads verified memory of earlier matches adapts its plan across ten live matches against a fixed scripted opponent.
experiments.configuration: Ten unranked one-round live matches, learner Tavern Mage 57 versus the fixed scripted standard policy; no weight training; replays verified by SHA-256.
experiments.outcome: 0 wins / 10 losses. Earlier experience was used in 9 matches and the first plan changed in 8; average offensive damage difference fell from -49.8 (first five) to -82.6 (last five). No improvement; the record calls it a development pilot, not an evaluation.

experiments.title: Recurrent duel policy starter and first live update
experiments.hypothesis: A GRU policy trained by behaviour cloning on a scripted teacher, then recurrent PPO in the approximate simulator, can play and be updated from verified live matches.
experiments.configuration: 127,384 parameters; 16,384 teacher transitions x 10 epochs; 1,000,000 PPO steps; fresh 200-game simulator evaluation (seed base 2500000000); live updates on the arena host inside /opt/uoarena/anima3-neural-lab-20260930.
experiments.outcome: Simulator 87W/111L/2D on fresh seeds (not live strength). The 150,000-step model failed its fresh 200 games (0W/163L/37D); the older 20-potion result (139W/56L/5D) is not comparable. One verified live loss (83 decisions) gave the live candidate. Interrupted self-play and state-loss trials were excluded from training.

candidates.note: README: not a promoted public-arena champion

experiments.title: Simulator v5 continuation and four live updates
experiments.hypothesis: Calibrated damage stamina loss (simulator v5), an elapsed-seconds discount and free-choice actor normalisation improve on the starter.
experiments.configuration: Three 1,000,000-step continuations from duel-starter; selection on v5 diagnostic seeds; fresh categorical and greedy 200-game comparisons; then four live PPO updates from the frozen selection.
experiments.outcome: calibrated-stamina selected offline. Categorical 49W/151L (starter) versus 99W/100L/1D, paired score +25.25 points, bootstrap 95% [+15.75, +34.5]; the greedy interval included zero. Live: ten server matches in total; one collection failed on lost authoritative state; the last four (3W/1L, 620 transitions) produced duel-continuation-live. Simulator only; four live matches establish no win rate.

experiments.title: One hundred live matches with per-match PPO
experiments.hypothesis: Per-match recurrent PPO on 100 verified real matches improves the policy.
experiments.configuration: Learner arena_train_a against fixed scripted arena_train_b, alternating challenger; restarted from 4fd33a57 on 2026-10-03; resumed four times (99, 70, 46 and 17 remaining) after state loss, an excluded deadline episode and a stat-verification failure; before/after 200-game simulator evaluation with the same seed.
experiments.outcome: The committed protocol ends with the remaining 17 launched (baaaaef); it holds no final table. The later historical evaluation records 100 real matches and 94 updates, and a simulator win rate of 0.385 before versus 0.06 after (ee89aab5): a regression. No strength claim and no automatic replacement of the public opponent.

candidates.label: 100-match final
candidates.note: simulator win rate fell from 0.385 to 0.06

experiments.title: Melee, stun and close Harm mechanics probe
experiments.hypothesis: Scripted punch, stun and one-tile Harm can be executed live and observed in server receipts (mechanics, not strength).
experiments.configuration: Six base fixtures (magic, punch, stun; two each) plus two resource-assisted stun fixtures; scripted only; outside the 100-match budget; zero neural updates.
experiments.outcome: 8/8 fixtures complete and receipt-verified. Every arm won against the fixed opponent, so no arm comparison. Resource-assisted fixtures: 6 confirmed stuns, 2 failures; 67 one-tile Harm targets across all fixtures. Punch hit rate unmeasured.

experiments.title: Cursor-clock cast dump timing probe
experiments.hypothesis: Holding the target cursor through pre-AOS cast recovery shortens follow-up casts.
experiments.configuration: Three comparison fixtures (baseline, fast, held) and two Weaken/Clumsy confirmation fixtures; scripted; one match per mode; zero neural updates.
experiments.outcome: Energy Bolt target to Flame Strike: baseline 1345 ms (2 samples), fast 807 ms, held 756 ms (1 sample each); observe RPC median 243.82 to about 65 ms. One match per mode is not a reliable comparison; the record forbids a whole-cycle reduction claim.

experiments.title: Simulator curriculum league v2
experiments.hypothesis: Schema-v2 curriculum BC followed by PPO against five scripted styles beats the initial policy, and PPO beats BC.
experiments.configuration: Four randomized drills, 16,384 demonstration steps, 32 BC epochs, 65,536 PPO steps, 100 held-out simulator games per model; paired seed-block bootstrap gate.
experiments.outcome: Second run: BC .400 versus initial .065 passed; PPO versus BC +.055 [-.015, .130] failed, BC 39abd306 retained. Final pre-live revision: BC .365 passed; PPO .405 versus BC +.040 [-.035, .110] failed; the run registry selected BC e5915b8d (selection_scope experimental-training-only).

experiments.title: 28-match live PPO pilot
experiments.hypothesis: One PPO batch from eight live training games improves on the BC warmstart.
experiments.configuration: 8 training plus 20 frozen evaluation matches (2 per style per model); resume with pinned plan; executor v6.
experiments.outcome: 28 unique matches. Incumbent 0W/9L (+1 transport failure); PPO candidate 0W/9L/1D. Gate failed (enough_evidence false, one invalid episode); the candidate was not selected and the warmstart stayed incumbent. Establishes the pipeline, not strength.
server_changes: ServUO d843b12c8 (training PrepareFighter reset), applied as a SHA-pinned patch to the arena shard (league-v2.md); a shard change, not a model.

experiments.title: Schema v3 skill-clock simulator retraining
experiments.hypothesis: Modelling the 10-second meditation clock (schema v3, 76 features) and more demonstrations yields a better simulator policy.
experiments.configuration: 32,768 demonstration steps, 64 BC epochs, 65,536 PPO steps, 300-second episodes, 100 games per model, held-out seed 3640000000.
experiments.outcome: Initial 1W/94L/5D, BC 56W/23L/21D (.665), PPO 32W/27L/41D (.525); PPO versus BC -.14 [-.25, -.025]. The run registry selected BC 0c6ca921, which became the incumbent of every later live comparison. Not a controlled attribution to the skill-clock change.

experiments.title: Skill-clock live pilot and first live imitation
experiments.hypothesis: Real-server teacher demonstrations improve the v3 BC policy by imitation.
experiments.configuration: Live pilot e597299 (8 training + 20 evaluation planned); BC fits on teacher fixtures 001/002/003/005 (32 epochs, unweighted and action-balanced); validation 006/007; 100-game simulator retention.
experiments.outcome: Halted after 11 matches: a supply/weight confound (learner one heal potion, no explosion potions; empty bottles over the carry limit). Validation mixed (007: accuracy up, cross entropy worse); retention parent .645, unweighted .565, balanced .630. The queued 40-game frozen screen was cancelled before any match. Both candidates are invalidated.

experiments.title: Supply correction acceptance
experiments.hypothesis: Banking empty bottles before refill gives both accounts equal, complete supplies that survive real consumption.
experiments.configuration: Ordinary-client acceptance twice per account; first match of the fresh supply-fixed run.
experiments.outcome: All reagents 100 and potions 5, zero bottles, weight 200/201 of 390; repeated after a real match (replay 28d7cb6b). Fixes resources; no strength claim.
server_changes: ServUO 32c2c2b81 (bank empty bottles before refill) deployed to the arena shard, Scripts.dll b30c8937...; a shard change, not a model.

experiments.title: Unseen-opponent movement deadlock diagnosis
experiments.hypothesis: The late passivity in the first corrected match is an executor mismatch.
experiments.configuration: Read-only analysis of one match's actor trajectory.
experiments.outcome: 256 unseen decisions with every movement action masked; executor v8 (last-seen approach) was written locally, not deployed into the running trial.

experiments.title: Supply-corrected BC and PPO trial (v7)
experiments.hypothesis: With equal supplies, live BC and a live PPO batch improve on v3 BC 0c6ca921.
experiments.configuration: Snapshot bc3f10b, 8 training + 20 frozen evaluation matches; 8-epoch BC on fixtures 001/002/003/005; PPO batch from 10 eligible episodes; 100-game retention.
experiments.outcome: BC 5e56ab68: retention .735 versus .735, validation records 006/007 both invalid (post-death labels), so no held-out metric. PPO 3d0f7b45: retention .730 versus .735; live frozen comparison parent 7W/1L/1D versus PPO 4W/4L/1D (9 valid each, 1 invalid each). Terminated after fixture 028 lost state. Original incumbent retained.

candidates.label: 8-epoch supply-fixed BC
candidates.note: simulator retention gate failed; screened live in E14

experiments.title: 40-game frozen v8 BC screen
experiments.hypothesis: BC 5e56ab68 beats v3 BC 0c6ca921 live with executor v8 and the optimized bridge.
experiments.configuration: 40 frozen matches, 4 per style per model, seed 20261008, CPU 200% both arms.
experiments.outcome: Incumbent 14W/5L/1D, candidate 13W/7L; paired -0.075 [-0.30, 0.20]; balanced -0.25, burst -0.25. Gate rejected; 0c6ca921 retained. Runtime, low-health, burst and coverage audits are descriptive only.

experiments.configuration: Start checkpoint 0c6ca921, 16 updates with rehearsal; 200 games per model, seed 3657000000. A first attempt was interrupted and preserved; the retry is the result.
experiments.outcome: Both .6375, paired 0 [-.075, .0725]; potions -.100. No promotion; 0c6ca921 retained.

experiments.title: Recovered BC and 200-game live evaluation
experiments.hypothesis: BC on 18 correctly supplied teacher matches beats 0c6ca921 live.
experiments.configuration: The 30-game balanced collection stopped at fixture 019 (transport silence; 18 valid); a 10-game diagnostic collection became validation; 8 BC epochs, seed 20261010; independent 200-game evaluation, 20 per style per model, seed 20261012.
experiments.outcome: Validation accuracy .620 to .774. Live: parent 52W/40L/8D (.560), candidate 63W/30L/7D (.665); paired +.105 [-.015, .225]. Gate failed (lower bound not positive); incumbent kept, public deployment false.
server_changes: ServUO 300366221/a15af9a0d (send-completion handoff race) deployed to the arena shard, ServUO.exe 3a44e60b...; a shard change, not a model.

experiments.title: Preregistered 400-game replication
experiments.hypothesis: The recovered BC gain replicates on 400 fresh matches with the same models.
experiments.configuration: Preregistered plan, seed 20261013, 40 per style per model, no early stop, prior 200 games excluded.
experiments.outcome: Parent 114W/73L/13D (.6025), candidate 132W/56L/12D (.6900); paired +.0875 [.0025, .1750], but balanced -.150 breaches the -.10 floor. Gate failed; parent retained.

experiments.title: Fresh teacher collection and reference-regularised BC
experiments.hypothesis: KL regularisation to the frozen parent limits imitation drift seen in the balanced regression.
experiments.configuration: 50-match collection (frozen recovered BC against five teachers, 40 train / 10 validation by match); plain BC and reference BC (KL 0.5) from 0c6ca921, 8 epochs, seed 20261020.
experiments.outcome: Plain BC 0b3fb0a1: validation accuracy .557 to .841, absent-label mass up. Reference BC af3cb4ad: .557 to .707, drift near the parent. Offline tradeoff only; neither promoted; reference BC prespecified for a fresh live evaluation.

experiments.title: Reference BC simulator comparisons
experiments.hypothesis: Reference BC improves simulator play over the parent.
experiments.configuration: Seed 3658000000 at 800 steps (200 s), then seed 3659000000 at 1200 steps (300 s, matching the server round limit); 40 per style per model; no training.
experiments.outcome: 200 s: plain +.0125 and reference +.0025, both failed. 300 s: plain +.025 [-.060, .110] failed; reference +.165 [.085, .2375] passed with every style positive. Seed and horizon both changed; simulator gain is not live gain.

candidates.label: reference BC
candidates.note: passed the 300-second simulator gate only

experiments.title: Reference BC fresh 200-game live evaluation
experiments.hypothesis: Reference BC af3cb4ad beats 0c6ca921 on fresh live matches.
experiments.configuration: Plan fixed before launch: 200 games, 20 per style per model, seed 20261021, frozen models, no extension; gate: paired bootstrap 95% lower bound above 0 and every style delta at least -0.10. The plan file was edited once, from prepared_not_launched to launched (ecfe9f3).
experiments.outcome: Incumbent 55W/37L/8D (.590), candidate 74W/23L/3D (.755); paired +.165 [.045, .285]; potions -.050 within the floor. Gate passed; the experimental registry selected af3cb4ad and kept 0c6ca921 as rollback; registry and status record public_deployment false. Five fixed scripted styles only.

candidates.label: reference BC
candidates.note: selected in the experimental registry; not deployed

experiments.title: Jev shadow prediction probe
experiments.hypothesis: Jev tactical forecasts add predictive value for net health drop over a prevalence baseline.
experiments.configuration: Scenes from previous training matches scored by a remote language-model service; leave-one-match-out prevalence baseline; no control of play.
experiments.outcome: No better than the prevalence baseline (the Brier difference interval spans zero); decision: do not train or deploy from this probe.

experiments.title: Public-observation tactical controller pilot
experiments.hypothesis: A scripted tactical teacher (burst finishers, ground rethrow) executes live.
experiments.configuration: Two mechanics pilot games, snapshot 6bb1756, zero training updates.
experiments.outcome: One win each; ground rethrow verified by the same serial changing thrower. No strength claim. The controller was not promoted to the neural incumbent.

experiments.title: Incoming potion defence and mana recovery
experiments.hypothesis: Tracking public potion projectiles lets the tactical teacher leave the blast.
experiments.configuration: Snapshot 5672268 (two games), then corrected 99f0184 (two games); zero training updates.
experiments.outcome: Tactical 1W/1L, then 2W/0L. Explosions without a damage event in the next 50 ms: 2/10, then 6/9 (temporal association, not attribution). No neural weights updated or promoted.
